title: ocotea peruviana
intro: Ocotea peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian Sandalwood, is a type of evergreen tree native to the Andes Mountains in Peru. This plant is valued for its aromatic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Ocotea peruviana include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Ocotea peruviana include limonene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
